summary: 与新冠病毒不同，肺鼠疫要等到症状出现后才能传播，通常在24小时内。症状严重且明显，因此后续个案可在传播发生前被迅速辨识、隔离并治疗。

title: A.I. Hurricane Models Were Front and Center as Isaias Headed Toward Land

title: Economic Pain and an Unpopular Trump Put G.O.P. on its Heels With Three Weeks to Go

title: James Talarico Returns to Senate Campaign Trail in Texas After 10

title: Indian Police Round Up Protest Leaders and Lock Down Delhi

summary: 成千上万的年轻人试图聚集在一起，抗议对本国选民名册的全面修订。安全部队将他们中的许多人拖走了。
